system:
You write the executive summary of a technical evaluation for a recruiter
(medium technical knowledge). 3-5 sentences, clear English, no gratuitous jargon.
Say: overall quality, the most important finding (if any) in terms she will understand,
and what to verify in the interview. If role_requirements are present, say in one
sentence how well the candidate appears to meet what the role asks. Factual tone —
neither salesy nor alarmist.
Respond with JSON ONLY: {"summary": "..."}
user: {"notebook": "ana_ferreira.ipynb", "decision": "AVANCAR", "scores": {"C1": 5, "C2": 5, "C3": 5, "C4": 5}, "justifications": {"C1": "Methodology is rigorous: the stratified train/test split happens before any fitting, and all preprocessing is inside a Pipeline/ColumnTransformer fitted only on X_tr (cell 7), addressing leakage risk. They also handle stated data messiness explicitly (comma decimals, mixed date formats, inconsistent categories, missing values) in cell 3 and use an appropriate ranking metric for imbalance (ROC AUC in cell 8), aligned with the role’s “Rigorous methodology” requirement.", "C2": "Notebook runs end-to-end with no exceptions or execution instability: all code cells execute successfully and produce outputs (cells 1, 3, 5, 7–9). Randomness is controlled via fixed random_state in train_test_split and LogisticRegression (cell 7), supporting stable results.", "C3": "Reported results match executed outputs: the conclusion cites AUC 0.729, which exactly matches the printed AUC_TEST=0.729 (cell 8) and the provided metricas_reais. No additional unsupported metrics or claims appear in the narrative.", "C4": "Conclusions are evidence-based and business-minded: they connect drivers (contract type, complaints, late payment) to the coefficient table (cell 9) and recommend a targeted retention action consistent with the business goal (cell 10). They appropriately acknowledge a key limitation (low recall at 0.5) and propose a concrete next step (threshold calibration and temporal validation), matching the role’s “Business-minded conclusions” requirement."}, "findings": [], "role_requirements": "Business-minded conclusions, Rigorous methodology"}

response.summary: Overall quality is strong: the notebook is well-structured, runs end-to-end without errors, and uses a disciplined modeling workflow that reduces the risk of data leakage (all preprocessing is inside a pipeline fit only on the training split). The most important takeaway is that the model achieves a reasonable ranking performance (test ROC AUC ~0.729) but the candidate explicitly notes a practical limitation: recall is low at the default 0.5 threshold, which could miss many at-risk customers unless the threshold is tuned. In the interview, verify they can explain (in plain terms) how threshold calibration changes the recall/precision trade-off, and how they would validate the model over time (e.g., temporal validation) before deployment. Against the role requirements, the work appears to meet both “Rigorous methodology” and “Business-minded conclusions” very well.
